column3: Close to the Hebrew; “there is no number” is rendered “infinite.”
Close to the Hebrew; מְעוֹדֵד (“lifts up”) is rendered “lifts up.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” is rendered “mercy.”
Close to the Hebrew; “who makes your border peace” is rendered “He makes peace in your borders.”
Close to the Hebrew; אִמְרָתוֹ (“his word”) is rendered “His command.”
Close to the Hebrew; קַרְחוֹ (“his ice”) is rendered “His hail.”
